notes: Eight web searches ran; none was refused. No campaign website was found: search results showed only his ActBlue page (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/haynes2026), which I opened and which does not mention AI (platform items listed there: ending US military funding for Israel, abolishing ICE, Medicare for All, getting dark money out of elections). Because no campaign site was found, no site-restricted search was possible. Ballotpedia (https://ballotpedia.org/Frederick_Haynes) returned an empty page when fetched; a search snippet said he had not completed the Ballotpedia 2026 Candidate Connection survey. He was not a House member in 2026, so he could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. A Texas Monthly piece on superintelligence that appeared in results is about Rep. Greg Casar, not Haynes. Sermons or church media from Friendship-West Baptist Church were not searched specifically and could contain remarks on AI.
